# bsvarPost

**bsvarPost** turns posterior draws from **bsvars** and **bsvarSIGNs**
into response summaries, model comparisons, posterior probability
statements, historical decompositions, and publication tables and plots.

## Installation

Install from GitHub (R \>= 4.1):

``` r

install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("DavidZenz/bsvarPost")
```

The online
[articles](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/articles/index.html)
are available without building vignettes. To install local HTML articles
as well:

``` r

install.packages(c("knitr", "rmarkdown"))
remotes::install_github("DavidZenz/bsvarPost", build_vignettes = TRUE)
```

## A complete first analysis

These installed demo fits use US log real per capita GDP, government
spending (`gs`), and tax revenue (`ttr`). The baseline has one lag; the
alternative has three. Each has **200 retained draws for
demonstration**, which does not establish sampling adequacy for an
empirical study. The introduction supplies the seeded [estimation
recipe](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/articles/bsvarPost.html#estimate-your-own-models).

``` r

library(bsvarPost)
post <- readRDS(system.file("extdata", "fiscal_post_bsvar.rds",
  package = "bsvarPost", mustWork = TRUE))
post_alt <- readRDS(system.file("extdata", "fiscal_post_bsvar_alt.rds",
  package = "bsvarPost", mustWork = TRUE))

responses <- tidy_irf(post, horizon = 12, probability = 0.90)
gdp <- subset(responses, variable == "gdp" & shock == "gs")
gdp[gdp$horizon %in% c(0, 4, 8, 12),
    c("horizon", "median", "lower", "upper")]
```

Horizons are quarters after the shock, including impact at zero. Bounds
are pointwise 90% equal-tailed credible intervals. Responses use the
fitted model’s structural-shock normalization and the original log
units.

``` r

comparison <- compare_cdm(baseline = post, longer_lag = post_alt,
  horizon = 12, probability = 0.90)
comparison_gdp <- subset(comparison, variable == "gdp" & shock == "gs")
comparison_plot <- ggplot2::autoplot(comparison_gdp) +
  ggplot2::labs(y = "Cumulative log response", x = "Quarters after shock")
comparison_plot

output <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
write_bsvar_csv(comparison_gdp, file = output)
read.csv(output, check.names = FALSE)[1:2,
  c("Model", "Horizon", "Median", "Interval method", "Draw count")]
```

A cumulative dynamic multiplier (CDM) sums each draw’s responses from
impact through the selected horizon. With these data it is a cumulative
log response; a dollar-per-dollar fiscal multiplier requires additional
conversion and a spending-response denominator. `scale_by = "shock_sd"`
divides by an observed variable’s sample standard deviation and does not
perform that conversion.

The default CSV export preserves provenance columns, including interval
mass and method, scaling, upstream computation version and draw count.
Keep these columns when passing results to collaborators. This exporter
uses readable column labels; the introduction also shows a fixed-schema
export. Economic units require your knowledge of the model’s
transformations.

## Choose a workflow

| Research question | Start here |
|----|----|
| How do I summarize, compare and export responses? | [Complete fiscal analysis](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/articles/bsvarPost.html) |
| How probable is a sign, magnitude or complete response path? | [Inference and comparison](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/articles/inference-and-comparison.html) |
| Which shocks contributed during an event? | [Historical decompositions](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/articles/historical-decomposition-events.html) |
| How do restrictions, representative draws and importance weights relate? | [Sign-restricted workflows](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/articles/sign-restricted-workflows.html) |

The [function
reference](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/index.html)
covers arguments and supported inputs, including FEVDs, forecasts and
structural shocks. In R, use
[`help(package = "bsvarPost")`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference),
[`?tidy_irf`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/tidy_irf.md)
or `vignette(package = "bsvarPost")` for installed documentation.

# Package index

## Posterior Summaries and Cumulative Dynamic Responses

- [`cdm()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/cdm.md) :
  Computes posterior draws of cumulative dynamic multipliers
- [`tidy_irf()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/tidy_irf.md)
  : Summarises posterior draws of impulse responses
- [`tidy_cdm()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/tidy_cdm.md)
  : Summarises posterior draws of cumulative dynamic multipliers
- [`tidy_fevd()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/tidy_fevd.md)
  : Summarises posterior draws of forecast error variance decompositions
- [`tidy_hd()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/tidy_hd.md)
  : Summarises posterior draws of historical decompositions
- [`tidy_forecast()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/tidy_forecast.md)
  : Summarises draws from the predictive distribution
- [`tidy_shocks()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/tidy_shocks.md)
  : Summarises posterior draws of structural shocks
- [`posterior_provenance`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/posterior_provenance.md)
  : Provenance columns in posterior tables

## Comparison of Model Specifications

- [`compare_irf()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/compare_irf.md)
  : Compares posterior impulse responses across model specifications
- [`compare_cdm()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/compare_cdm.md)
  : Compares cumulative dynamic multipliers across model specifications
- [`compare_fevd()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/compare_fevd.md)
  : Compares forecast error variance decompositions across model
  specifications
- [`compare_forecast()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/compare_forecast.md)
  : Compares posterior forecasts across model specifications

## Posterior Hypotheses and Simultaneous Inference

- [`hypothesis_irf()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/hypothesis_irf.md)
  : Evaluates posterior probability statements for impulse responses
- [`hypothesis_cdm()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/hypothesis_cdm.md)
  : Evaluates posterior probability statements for cumulative dynamic
  multipliers
- [`joint_hypothesis_irf()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/joint_hypothesis_irf.md)
  : Evaluates joint posterior probability statements for impulse
  responses
- [`joint_hypothesis_cdm()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/joint_hypothesis_cdm.md)
  : Evaluates joint posterior probability statements for cumulative
  dynamic multipliers
- [`magnitude_audit()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/magnitude_audit.md)
  : Evaluates magnitude hypotheses for impulse responses or cumulative
  multipliers
- [`simultaneous_irf()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/simultaneous_irf.md)
  : Computes simultaneous posterior bands for impulse responses
- [`simultaneous_cdm()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/simultaneous_cdm.md)
  : Computes simultaneous posterior bands for cumulative dynamic
  multipliers
- [`plot_hypothesis()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/plot_hypothesis.md)
  : Plots posterior probability statements for impulse responses or
  cumulative multipliers
- [`plot_joint_hypothesis()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/plot_joint_hypothesis.md)
  : Plots joint posterior probability statements
- [`plot_simultaneous()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/plot_simultaneous.md)
  : Plots simultaneous posterior bands

## Representative Posterior Draws and Response Timing

- [`representative_irf()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/representative_irf.md)
  : Selects a representative draw of impulse responses
- [`representative_cdm()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/representative_cdm.md)
  : Selects a representative draw of cumulative dynamic multipliers
- [`median_target_irf()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/median_target_irf.md)
  : Selects the median-target draw of impulse responses
- [`median_target_cdm()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/median_target_cdm.md)
  : Selects the median-target draw of cumulative dynamic multipliers
- [`peak_response()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/peak_response.md)
  : Summarises peak responses from posterior draws
- [`duration_response()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/duration_response.md)
  : Summarises response durations from posterior draws
- [`half_life_response()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/half_life_response.md)
  : Summarises response half-lives from posterior draws
- [`time_to_threshold()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/time_to_threshold.md)
  : Summarises response threshold horizons from posterior draws
- [`compare_peak_response()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/compare_peak_response.md)
  : Compares peak responses across model specifications
- [`compare_duration_response()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/compare_duration_response.md)
  : Compares response durations across model specifications
- [`compare_half_life_response()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/compare_half_life_response.md)
  : Compares response half-lives across model specifications
- [`compare_time_to_threshold()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/compare_time_to_threshold.md)
  : Compares response thresholds across model specifications
- [`plot_compare_response()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/plot_compare_response.md)
  : Plots response timing and persistence across model specifications

## Historical Decompositions and Structural-Shock Contributions

- [`tidy_hd_event()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/tidy_hd_event.md)
  : Summarises historical-decomposition contributions over selected
  periods
- [`compare_hd_event()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/compare_hd_event.md)
  : Compares historical-period shock contributions across model
  specifications
- [`shock_ranking()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/shock_ranking.md)
  : Ranks structural shocks by contributions over selected periods
- [`plot_shock_ranking()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/plot_shock_ranking.md)
  : Plots ranked shock contributions over selected historical periods
- [`plot_hd_event()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/plot_hd_event.md)
  : Plots shock contributions over selected historical periods
- [`plot_hd_event_share()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/plot_hd_event_share.md)
  : Plots event contribution shares
- [`plot_hd_event_cumulative()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/plot_hd_event_cumulative.md)
  : Plots cumulative event-window contribution paths
- [`plot_hd_event_distribution()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/plot_hd_event_distribution.md)
  : Plots event-window contribution uncertainty by shock
- [`plot_hd_lines()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/plot_hd_lines.md)
  : Plots full-sample historical decomposition components
- [`plot_hd_overlay()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/plot_hd_overlay.md)
  : Plots overlaid historical decomposition component paths
- [`plot_hd_stacked()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/plot_hd_stacked.md)
  : Plots stacked historical decomposition contributions over time
- [`plot_hd_total()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/plot_hd_total.md)
  : Plots observed and reconstructed decomposition totals

## Sign Restrictions and Identification Diagnostics

- [`most_likely_admissible_irf()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/most_likely_admissible_irf.md)
  : Selects the most-likely admissible draw of impulse responses
- [`most_likely_admissible_cdm()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/most_likely_admissible_cdm.md)
  : Selects the most-likely admissible draw of cumulative dynamic
  multipliers
- [`irf_restriction()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/irf_restriction.md)
  : Specifies an impulse-response restriction
- [`structural_restriction()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/structural_restriction.md)
  : Specifies a structural restriction
- [`narrative_restriction()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/narrative_restriction.md)
  : Specifies a narrative restriction
- [`restriction_audit()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/restriction_audit.md)
  : Evaluates sign, zero, structural, and narrative restrictions
- [`acceptance_diagnostics()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/acceptance_diagnostics.md)
  : Summarises acceptance and admissibility diagnostics for bsvarSIGNs
- [`compare_restrictions()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/compare_restrictions.md)
  : Compares posterior restriction probabilities across model
  specifications
- [`compare_acceptance_diagnostics()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/compare_acceptance_diagnostics.md)
  : Compares acceptance diagnostics across model specifications
- [`plot_restriction_audit()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/plot_restriction_audit.md)
  : Plots posterior restriction probabilities
- [`plot_compare_restrictions()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/plot_compare_restrictions.md)
  : Plots posterior restriction probabilities across model
  specifications
- [`plot_acceptance_diagnostics()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/plot_acceptance_diagnostics.md)
  : Plots acceptance diagnostics across model specifications

## Figures and Tables

- [`autoplot(`*`<bsvar_post_tbl>`*`)`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/autoplot.bsvar_post_tbl.md)
  : Plots posterior summaries or draw-level response paths
- [`theme_bsvarpost()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/theme_bsvarpost.md)
  : Defines a plot theme for posterior summaries
- [`style_bsvar_plot()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/style_bsvar_plot.md)
  : Applies a consistent graphical style to posterior summaries
- [`template_bsvar_plot()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/template_bsvar_plot.md)
  : Applies graphical conventions for a posterior quantity
- [`annotate_bsvar_plot()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/annotate_bsvar_plot.md)
  : Adds titles and captions to posterior-summary plots
- [`publish_bsvar_plot()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/publish_bsvar_plot.md)
  : Plots posterior results with consistent graphical conventions
- [`report_bundle()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/report_bundle.md)
  : Combines posterior summaries, figures, and captions
- [`report_table()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/report_table.md)
  : Prepares tables of posterior results
- [`as_kable()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/as_kable.md)
  : Formats posterior summaries with knitr::kable
- [`as_gt()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/as_gt.md)
  : Formats posterior summaries with gt
- [`as_flextable()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/as_flextable.md)
  : Formats posterior summaries with flextable
- [`write_bsvar_csv()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/write_bsvar_csv.md)
  : Writes posterior summaries to a CSV file
- [`print(`*`<bsvar_report_bundle>`*`)`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/print.bsvar_report_bundle.md)
  : Prints posterior report objects

## Interfaces with Other R Packages

- [`as_tsibble_post()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/as_tsibble_post.md)
  : Converts posterior summaries to a tsibble
- [`as_apr_cond_forc()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/as_apr_cond_forc.md)
  : Converts posterior forecasts to APRScenario format
- [`tidy_apr_forecast()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/tidy_apr_forecast.md)
  : Converts APRScenario forecasts to posterior summary tables
- [`apr_gen_mats()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/apr_gen_mats.md)
  : Computes conditional-forecast matrices with APRScenario

## Input Validation and Compatibility

- [`resolve_horizon()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/resolve_horizon.md)
  : Resolve horizon to a validated integer, defaulting to 20
- [`validate_horizon()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/validate_horizon.md)
  : Validate a horizon parameter
- [`validate_probability()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/validate_probability.md)
  : Validate a probability parameter
- [`validate_posterior_object()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/validate_posterior_object.md)
  : Validate a posterior model object
- [`deprecate_arg()`](https://davidzenz.github.io/bsvarPost/reference/deprecate_arg.md)
  : Handle deprecated argument with warning
